typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBOTCTradeAuditing_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		WORKFLOW_ID as decimal(38,0),
		STATUS as string,
		POSSIBLE_ACTION as string,
		RESULTING_STATUS as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		CREATE_DTE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBCalypso
OLEDBCalypso derive(oSTATUS = STATUS,
		oPOSSIBLE_ACTION = POSSIBLE_ACTION,
		oCOMMENTS = COMMENTS,
		oRESULTING_STATUS = RESULTING_STATUS,
		oCREATE_DTE = CREATE_DTE,
		oWORKFLOW_ID = toString(WORKFLOW_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Comments as string,
		Workflow_ID as string,
		Original_Status as string,
		Possible_Action as string,
		Resulting_Status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Create_Dte = oCREATE_DTE,
		Comments = oCOMMENTS,
		Workflow_ID = oWORKFLOW_ID,
		Original_Status = oSTATUS,
		Possible_Action = oPOSSIBLE_ACTION,
		Resulting_Status = oRESULTING_STATUS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBOTCTradeAuditing_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBOTCTradeAuditing
